episode.title: This GIANT WOOLLY MAMMOUTH Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a desert ruins set, a colossal woolly mammoth takes a performer into its mouth, then the crew manually open its jaws and he emerges unscathed.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man, who stands his ground and watches its jaws begin to part.

A wide shot of Ihsan, dressed in a rugged jacket, standing on the pale sand dunes of the desert ruins set. Before him, a colossal, lifelike woolly mammoth head practical prop, shaggy brown fur with dusty, matted texture, small, intelligent brown eyes, and massive curved tusks, standing 5 metres tall, slowly begins to open its powerful mouth. Dust motes dance in the studio light. Ambient sound only: faint desert wind, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The creature's jaws open wide and close over exactly one man until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with the man nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming.

A wide shot showing the colossal, lifelike woolly mammoth head practical prop, shaggy brown fur with dusty, matted texture, small, intelligent brown eyes, and massive curved tusks, standing 5 metres tall, its mouth wide open, completely engulfing Ihsan. The mouth then closes with a soft thud. The mammoth's shaggy fur catches the studio light. Ambient sound only: soft thud, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and the same one man climbs out of the mouth onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal.

A wide shot of the colossal, lifelike woolly mammoth head practical prop, shaggy brown fur with dusty, matted texture, small, intelligent brown eyes, and massive curved tusks, standing 5 metres tall. Several crew members in black, using long poles and levers, manually pry open its strong, muscular mouth. Ihsan, completely unharmed, climbs out of the dark, cavernous interior of the prop onto the sandy desert floor, brushing dust from his jacket. Ambient sound only: creaking levers, studio air handling and distant crew movement.
